verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (HTTP Basic Auth, paginated endpoints such as candidate.create and application.list), webhooks and an MCP server. None of it mentions an official SDK or client library in any language, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no published spec for generating clients either. A raw API is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so the axis applies but is not evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
